terms.gloss: shut up, close fast (a door, a house, a shop)
evidence: Plaut. Aul. 89: abī intrō, occlūde jānuam
Plaut. Most. 425: clāvem cedo atque abī intrō atque occlūde ōstium
terms.comment: To shoot the bolt is obserāre or pessulum obdere.

phrases.latin: Abī intrō, occlūde jānuam. Jam ego hīc erō.
phrases.english: Go in and lock the door. I’ll be back in a moment.

phrases.latin: clāvem cedo atque abī intrō atque occlūde ōstium
phrases.english: give me the key, and go in and lock the door
